cleared.check: Task 1. Every file that differs between evm2 7c9f3b6d (Tempo v1.19.2 and tempo main) and e80df9c4 (reth main) in crates/evm2, macros, inspectors and jit. crawl.py mirrored e80df9c4 (176 files) in this session; the 7c9f3b6d tree is cycle 33's mirror, completed with evm/bal/account.rs, and 13 of its files were fetched again in this session and are byte equal to the mirror. Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock were fetched at both revisions.
cleared.result: Thirteen files differ and one file is present in both. Interpreter: only interpreter/instructions/arithmetic.rs, lines 22 and 32: DIV changes from `if b.is_zero() { Word::ZERO } else { a.wrapping_div(*b) }` to `a.checked_div(*b).unwrap_or_default()`, MOD from `if b.is_zero() { Word::ZERO } else { a.wrapping_rem(*b) }` to `a.checked_rem(*b).unwrap_or_default()`. SDIV and SMOD (i256_div and i256_mod, arithmetic.rs:27 and :37, i256.rs byte equal), ADDMOD (a.add_mod, :42), MULMOD (a.mul_mod, :47) and EXP (a.wrapping_pow, :53) are the same text at both revisions. Instruction set, bytecode analysis, interpreter memory, stack, dispatch, evm/mod.rs, evm/tx.rs and evm/state are byte equal. Outside the interpreter: utils.rs:82-83 converts a word to an address with Address::from_word((*self).into()) instead of B256::from(self.to_be_bytes()), and drops the unused left_pad helper; version/gas_params.rs:258 charges EXP per byte with power.byte_len() instead of power.bit_len().div_ceil(8); precompiles/modexp.rs:171-177 rewrites the iteration count and the high part padding; bn254/arkworks.rs, bls12_381/arkworks.rs, crypto.rs (RIPEMD-160 left padding) and secp256k1/mod.rs are rewritten without a change of meaning as read; the inspectors crate changes only tracing output helpers. Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock are byte equal at both revisions and lock ruint 1.21.1 and alloy-primitives 1.7.3. The full diff is out/tree-7c9f3b6d-e80df9c4.diff in the work directory.

cleared.check: Whether the new DIV and MOD, the new word to address conversion and the new EXP byte count compute the old words, read in the library sources the lock pins (ruint 1.21.1, alloy-primitives 1.7.3).
cleared.result: Yes. ruint 1.21.1 src/div.rs:9-14 and :36-41 return None for a zero divisor and otherwise Some(self.div(rhs)) and Some(self.rem(rhs)); impl_bin_op (src/macros.rs:11-51, applied at div.rs:149-150) maps Div and Rem to wrapping_div and wrapping_rem, the routines the old code called, and Default is ZERO (src/lib.rs:371-375). The quotient and remainder for a nonzero divisor therefore run the same limb code at both revisions, and a zero divisor still gives 0. byte_len is defined as bit_len().div_ceil(8) (src/bits.rs:330-332), so EXP gas is unchanged. alloy-primitives 1.7.3 converts U256 into B256 with to_be_bytes (bits/fixed.rs:183-191, the U256 => B256 entry at :236) and Address::from_word keeps bytes 12..32 (bits/address.rs:134-136), the same address as before, so CALL, BALANCE and EXTCODE targets are unchanged. UnsafeMath.divRoundingUp (src/libraries/UnsafeMath.sol:14) and the divisions of FullMath (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:35, :62, :67, :73) get the same words.

cleared.check: Task 3 by reading, since the harness could not be built: what an open unlock sees after a transaction dispatched from inside the running one ends normally, reverts or is discarded, in evm2 e80df9c4 (evm/mod.rs, evm/tx.rs and evm/state/mod.rs are byte equal to 7c9f3b6d).
cleared.result: execute_tx (evm/mod.rs:1399-1420) saves only the frame pointer, the refund counter and the suspended frame count; the State is shared. A nested transaction reads the outer one's transient map, so it sees IS_UNLOCKED_SLOT (src/libraries/Lock.sol:8) set and can pass onlyWhenUnlocked. Every way it ends clears the whole transaction scratch: a handler error clears it in execute_tx (mod.rs:1415-1417), a finalisation error in finish_executed_tx (mod.rs:1041-1043), ExecutedTx::commit calls commit_transaction and then clear_transaction_state (tx.rs:231-237), discard and drop call clear_pending_state (tx.rs:223-228, :365-369), and an EVM-level revert returns Ok and takes the commit or discard path. clear_transaction_state (state/mod.rs:564-580) empties transient_storage, the journal, warm sets, logs and the account overlay. After the inner transaction the outer frame's TLOAD (state/mod.rs:841-843) returns 0 for the lock slot, NONZERO_DELTA_COUNT_SLOT (src/libraries/NonzeroDeltaCount.sol:9-10), every currency delta (src/libraries/CurrencyDelta.sol:18-23) and CURRENCY_SLOT (src/libraries/CurrencyReserves.sol:13) in all three outcomes. Calls inside the callback then revert ManagerLocked, and the check in unlock (src/PoolManager.sol:112) reads a count of 0 and accepts debts taken before the inner transaction; on commit the overlay that held the outer transaction's earlier transfers is written to the accepted state, on discard it is dropped, and in both cases the outer journal is gone, so a later revert of the outer frame cannot undo them. This is what a future caller of the path would do. Precompile providers receive &mut Evm (evm/precompile.rs:79-84), so a chain precompile is the place such a caller would appear.

cleared.check: Whether the evm2 revision change and its nested dispatch path apply to the 19 networks that run neither reth nor Tempo's client.
cleared.result: They do not apply today. Per OPCODES.md those networks run go-ethereum forks, Nitro, bor, avalanchego, Monad's client, mega-evm, the closed HyperEVM validator, op-reth, Base and other reth forks on stock revm. OPCODES.md records that the op-reth release candidate links evm2 without wiring it into the node. A reth-derived network inherits e80df9c4 only when it rebases on a reth release that carries it and wires evm2 in.

leadResults.answer: Between 7c9f3b6d and e80df9c4 the only interpreter file that changes is arithmetic.rs (DIV and MOD now use ruint checked_div and checked_rem with unwrap_or_default). In ruint 1.21.1, locked by both revisions, these return None only for a zero divisor and otherwise call the same wrapping_div and wrapping_rem, so DIV and MOD give the old word. The transcription matches evm.py on 198,071 DIV, MOD and DIVUP vectors including zero and full-width divisors, the 356 PoolManager scripts that finish give pyevm's return data, and four planted faults are caught. The other changes (word to address conversion, EXP byte count, modexp count, precompile encodings) compute the same values as read. No release carries e80df9c4 yet; the native build was refused and is left as a lead.

callers.py rerun today on tempo main (evm2 7c9f3b6d) and reth main (evm2 e80df9c4) finds no production caller that starts a transaction while a user transaction runs; tempo main's production list equals cycle 33's apart from line numbers. Read in e80df9c4, every end of a nested transaction (commit, discard, drop, handler or finalisation error) runs clear_transaction_state, so an open unlock would read 0 for the lock slot, NonzeroDeltaCount, its deltas and the synced currency afterwards, and src/PoolManager.sol:112 would accept unpaid debts. The rerun is still needed on every release of either client.
